questions.prompt: Which of these are star signs?
questions.fact: Orion and Pegasus are constellations too, but the Sun never passes in front of them, so they are not signs of the zodiac.

questions.prompt: Which of these are Grand Slam tennis tournaments?
questions.fact: Wimbledon is the only Grand Slam still played on grass.

questions.prompt: How many days does a human pregnancy last, on average?
questions.fact: Forty weeks, counted from the start of the last period, so a baby is really growing for about 38 of them.

questions.prompt: How long is a tennis court, in metres?
questions.fact: 78 feet from baseline to baseline, set down in the 1870s.

questions.prompt: Which Shakespeare play features the moneylender Shylock?
questions.hint: It is set in an Italian city of canals.
questions.fact: Shylock demands a pound of flesh as his price for an unpaid loan.

questions.prompt: Which philosopher taught Alexander the Great?
questions.fact: Aristotle taught the young Alexander for about three years.

Second landing site on the feed. Name it and the fleet moves.
